title: PUT /books/{id} returns 404 for a missing id rather than creating (no upsert)
evidence: handler.go:122 updateBook returns 404 when store.UpdateBook returns nil; store.go:118 returns nil when RowsAffected==0
suggestion: Acceptable per spec (PUT updates existing); note only if upsert semantics are desired

title: No SetMaxOpenConns(1) on the SQLite handle
evidence: store.go:18 sql.Open("sqlite", path) leaves the default connection pool; concurrent writers on a file DB can hit SQLITE_BUSY
suggestion: Call db.SetMaxOpenConns(1) for the modernc file-backed DB to serialize writes

title: Year validation rejects negatives but not future/implausible years
suggestion: Optional; spec only requires title/author validation, which is present
